svg.title: Auditable history, replay branches and source withdrawal
svg.desc: Causal ledgers and optional external checkpoints preserve inspectable history. Policy and retrieval replay create branches without publication authority. Authorized source revocation deactivates affected assertions transactionally; optional later cached-content erasure makes exact replay unavailable while retaining tombstone audit metadata.
